summary_en: Mitsui O.S.K. Lines authorized repurchase of up to 9.0 million shares (2.62% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 50.0 billion yen via market purchase on TSE from November 10, 2026 through March 31, 2027, targeting ROE exceeding 10% through improved capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On November 9, 2026, Mitsui O.S.K. Lines' Board of Directors authorized the repurchase of up to 9 million shares (2.62% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock as of September 30, 2026) for a maximum of 50 billion yen. The repurchase will be executed via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 10, 2026 and March 31, 2027.

The company intends to cancel the acquired shares as a general rule. The repurchase is undertaken to enhance shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency under the Group's medium-term management plan "BLUE ACTION 2035" Phase 2, which prioritizes balanced promotion of growth investment, financial soundness, and shareholder returns. The company targets a combined total payout ratio of approximately 40% through dividends and opportunistic share repurchases to return excess profits arising from favorable market conditions, while maintaining stable and predictable dividend policies.

This repurchase initiative supports the company's goal to achieve ROE exceeding 10% by strengthening earnings capacity and improving capital efficiency alongside enhanced dividend stability and predictability. The execution scale and timing will be determined based on business performance progress, in line with the dividend policy. Market conditions may result in partial or no execution of this authorization.
